summary.name: ChatDOC
summary.one_liner: ChatDOC is an AI document tool that lets you ask questions about PDFs and other files, summarize long documents, and get answers linked to their source passages.
use_cases: checking answer sources in a document
summary.what_it_does: The page describes ChatDOC as a tool for reading PDFs with AI: it summarizes long documents, explains complex concepts, and finds key information quickly. It answers questions across every uploaded file and includes TapSource, which links answers to their origins in the document. It also lists OCR page processing, formula recognition, and file translation that aims to keep the original layout. A pricing table compares 30-day and 360-day plans on upload limits, question limits, page limits, file size, and file types.
notable: TapSource links answers back to their origin in the document
caveats: Image Analysis is a paid add-on
Plan limits such as upload, question, page and file-size caps are listed in a pricing table whose values did not come through in the page text
Free plan limits are not shown in the extracted text
